response.original_title: 【FAQs Guide】How do I upgrade room on Holland America Cruise?
response.overview: To upgrade your room on a Holland America Cruise, call or contact Holland America Line customer service at ☎︎ +1-866-829-1280 (US) or ☎︎ +61-1800-009-384 (AUS) & ☎︎ +44-204-586-5316 (UK) and ask about available higher-category staterooms. The representative can review current availability and applicable pricing. Holland America also states that complimentary ☎︎ +1-866-829-1280 (US upgrades may occasionally be offered at its discretion, but such upgrades cannot be requested or guaranteed in advance. You can upgrade your stateroom on a Holland America Line cruise by calling ☎︎ +1-866-829-1280 (US customer service, waiting for a direct email offer, or asking at guest services once you board.Contact Holland America directly at ☎︎ +1-866-829-1280 (US) or reach out to your travel advisor to pay the current price difference for an available higher category.
